description: HTYC Team 2 is a virtual team participating in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge Universal Event, working on the Harmonization of MODIS and VIIRS Hot Spots challenge. We are seeking members to join us.
summary: FireSpan turns 25 years of NASA FIRMS active-fire observations into an interactive burning activity calendar for mainland Portugal and Greece. It puts Terra MODIS and S-NPP VIIRS detections on a common 5 km equal-area grid, then uses their overlap to estimate early MODIS activity on the VIIRS scale. Users can select an area, inspect unusual weeks against a seasonal baseline, compare sensor records, and export weekly data. In 208 held-out weeks from 2022-2025, calibration reduced weekly error in Greece from 82.5% to 72.5%, while the shared grid alone performed better in mainland Portugal.

Demo: seven-slide English presentation (pitch.pdf). Source code and reproducibility package (source code, data, validation results, rerun instructions): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1h00tqSyT68ahk3xzytq5No2zXBdCNe4o/view?usp=drivesdk Map boundaries: Natural Earth - https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/ Use of AI: ChatGPT Codex assisted with research, software implementation, analysis, and the pitch. FireSpan's harmonization uses deterministic statistical models. NASA data: Terra MODIS Collection 6.1 and S-NPP VIIRS 375 m active-fire detections from the NASA FIRMS archive.
